title: CakeFest 2016 - The CakePHP Conference
content:
Every summer we hold our annual conference dedicated to . For the past 11 years, the framework has been a benchmark for PHP development, providing developers with a full stack MVC solution to build powerful applications which scale. This, coupled with an amazing community backing and thousands of plugins, makes the number one choice for those who love code.CakePHPCakePHP

That's why we ask you join us at which will be running from May 26th till May 29th, and experience open source at it's very best! As always, will consist of a two day workshop (At beginner and advanced levels) and a two day conference. This year we are in the beautiful city of Amsterdam, Netherlands.CakeFest 2016CakeFest

The workshop sessions at are an ideal way to learn whether you are just starting out, or you are a seasoned developer. They are also a great way to get up to speed with the latest versions and innovations within the framework. All this, directly from the core developers themselves! The workshops will be on May 26th and May 27th. CakeFestCakePHP

Comprising two jam-packed days of presentations, discussions and talks on related technologies. The conference portion of is an event not to miss, for both new and old users of the framework. The conference will be on May 28th and May 29th and we have some fantastic lined up. CakePHPCakeFestspeakers

are selling fast, so you better grab yours while you still can!Tickets
